title: Nations League 2026-27 draw: England to play Spain, France face Italy
content:
England have been drawn against European champions Spain in Group A3 of the 2026-27 UEFA Nations League.

Thomas Tuchel’s side are competing in League A for the upcoming campaign after finishing top of Group B2 in the 2024-25 edition of the tournament. England last played Spain in the final of Euro 2024, with Mikel Oyarzabal scoring the winner in 86th minute as Spain lifted the trophy for a fourth time.

Alongside Spain, England will also play home and away fixtures against Croatia and the Czech Republic in Group A3.

Elsewhere in League A, France will take on Italy in a battle of former world champions, with Belgium and Turkey also placed in Group A1.

Wales, who were also promoted from League B last season, have been drawn against Nations League champions Portugal in Group A4, as well as Denmark and Norway.

In Group A2, rivals Germany and the Netherlands have been pitted together, alongside Serbia and Greece.

In League B, Scotland have been drawn against Switzerland, Slovenia and North Macedonia in Group B1, while the Republic of Ireland will face Israel, Austria and Kosovo in Group B2. Northern Ireland are in Group B3 with Hungary, Ukraine and Georgia.

The UEFA Nations League was created to minimise friendlies with nothing on the line and give teams competitive encounters with equally-ranked teams during international breaks.

The Nations League was first held in September 2018, with Portugal winning the inaugural tournament by beating the Netherlands 1-0 in the final at the Estadio do Dragao in June 2019.

Portugal won the tournament for the second time last summer, beating Spain via a penalty shootout in the final in June 2025.

Group A1: France, Italy, Belgium, Turkey
Group A2: Germany, Netherlands, Serbia, Greece
Group A3: Spain, Croatia, England, Czech Republic
Group A4: Portugal, Denmark, Norway, Wales

Group B1: Scotland, Switzerland, Slovenia, North Macedonia
Group B2: Hungary, Ukraine, Georgia, Northern Ireland
Group B3: Israel, Austria, Republic of Ireland, Kosovo
Group B4: Poland, Bosnia & Herzegovina, Romania, Sweden

Group C1: Albania, Finland, Belarus, San Marino
Group C2: Montenegro, Armenia, Cyprus, Gibraltar/Latvia*
Group C3: Kazakhstan, Slovakia, Faroe Islands, Moldova
Group C4: Iceland, Bulgaria, Estonia, Malta/Luxembourg*

Group D1: Gibraltar/Latvia*, Malta/Luxembourg*, Andorra
Group D2: Lithuania, Azerbaijan, Liechtenstein

*Gibraltar will play Latvia, while Malta take on Luxembourg in a play-0ff in March to determine final league placings.

League phase

Matchday 1: September 24-26, 2026
Matchday 2: September 27-29, 2026
Matchday 3: September 30 – October 3, 2026
Matchday 4: October 4-6, 2026
Matchday 5: November 12-14, 2026
Matchday 6: November 15-17, 2026

Quarter-finals, League A/B and League B/C promotion/relegation play-offs – March 25-30, 2027

League C/D play-offs – March 23-28, 2028

Final tournament – June 9-13, 2027

After the conclusion of the league phase in November 2026, the teams in League A that accumulate the most points will progress to the quarter-finals which will be held in March 2027.

Following the conclusion of the quarter-finals, the four remaining teams will compete in the finals between June 9 and June 13 2027.

The 2026-27 Nations League has wider implications beyond the tournament itself.

The best-performing teams in the Nations League that fail to qualify for the 2028 European Championship from the qualification campaign will enter play-offs to earn the final qualifying spots for the tournament.
